The '''Ylix system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[M'shinni sector/Legends|M'shinni sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ylix]].
